entities.name: Juan Martínez de Recalde
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Admiral Juan Martínez de Recalde, KOS was a Spanish Navy officer who was named admiral of the fleet and second-in-command of the Spanish Armada, and commanded the San Juan de Portugal. He was a knight of the Order of Santiago.
